name: Show & Tell Short
tagline: Raw talking-head clips go in, a tight vertical short that shows what you talk about while you say it comes out.
description: A vertical short where you talk in the bottom of the frame and the top shows what you're saying as you say it: the real product, logos, results, a prompt being typed, the steps of a process. Pauses and earlier takes are cut out (the last take of every line stays), and a title and then captions sit on the line between the two halves.
bring: Your raw recording of you talking to camera
Optional: screen recordings, images or clips of what you talk about
Optional: where it will be posted and how long it should be
get: A 30–90 s vertical video: you below, animated scenes above, captions on the seam

needs.name: Hyperframes, or the video tool your project already uses

stylesNote: colors, fonts, the background, cards and the title and caption pills

featuredStyles.note: Dark: near-black ground with purple and warm glows, dark cards and pills with light text, an orange-to-violet accent. Set these look roles (references/layout.md); keep meaning colours (red, green, code) as they are.

Warm paper: cream ground with a yellow highlighter glow, off-white cards, black ink, a red-pen accent, Archivo Black for every 800-weight line. Set these look roles (references/layout.md); keep meaning colours as they are.

steps: Cut the pauses and keep the last take of every line
Plan one animated scene for each idea, showing the real thing when you name it
Add the title, captions and sound effects
Review each version in FrameJam until it's right
